texts.zh:
我们现在拥有制造义体植入体的科技，和进行批量安装的能力。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

未来，拥有植入体和至少入门级别的义体将是我们在建的科技社会运作的必须条件。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
texts.en:
We now possess both the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants and the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to begin the surgical grafting process on our citizens.

In the future, possessing neural implants and at least a rudimentary level of cybernetics will be necessary to function in the technological society we are building. Consequently, the conversion process to install a basic cybernetics suite will be mandatory and free of cost to all of our citizens.

texts.zh:
我们如今已重获制造先进义体植入体的科技以及进行大规模生产的手段。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

从我们社会有记忆的一天起，义体就已经是我们生活的基本组成部分了，未来也当继续如此——只不过我们已经获得了自主权。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
texts.en:
We have now reclaimed the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants, and devised the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to surgically remove outdated augments and begin grafting new hardware onto our citizens.

Cybernetics have been a fundamental part of our lives for as long as our society can remember, and so that shall remain - on our own terms. Consequently, the conversion process to re-install a basic cybernetics suite will be mandatory and free of cost to all our citizens.

label.zh: 我们必须拥护这项科技。

texts.zh:
当有更有效率的东西出现时，一味坚持陈旧、衰老的东西是一个愚蠢的决定。

我们现有的科技水平使得神经植入体能够应用于我们[Root.GetName]的全体国民。我们的公民在四肢和器官被改良型的机械版本替换之后，将会变得更强、更快、更聪明。
texts.en:
It is a fool who persists in clinging to a worn, decrepit instrument when a more efficient alternative presents itself.

We now possess the technology to make cybernetic implants available to the population of the [Root.GetName] at large. Our citizens will be stronger, faster and more intelligent as limbs and organs are replaced with improved mechanical versions.

texts.zh:
义体加装转换工作完成！我们所有的公民现已加装神经植入体和基础的义体装束。设施也被保留了下来以便逐渐改造我们国家新出生的公民，所以他们在很早的年纪就能享受到科技的全部福祉。

从今往后，我们物种将被称作[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
texts.en:
The cybernetic conversion process has been completed! All of our citizens have now been equipped with neural implants and basic cybernetic suites. The infrastructure is also in place to gradually modify any new citizens that are born within our nation, so that they can experience all the benefits of technology from an early age.

Henceforth, our species shall be known as the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

label.en: It is the dawn of a new era.

texts.zh:
有消息传来，[From.GetName]境内发生了显著的变化。看起来他们完全接受了义体科技。对他们的公民来说，通过外科手术加装义体和神经植入体是强制性的。

这对他们的社会造成了显著改变——来自[From.Capital.GetName]的报告指出，连一些最简单的行为比如坐电梯和驾驶空中汽车都需要依靠义体植入体。实际上，他们物种的变化十分显著，乃至他们现在已经改称自己为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”。
texts.en:
Word is leaking out of significant changes taking place within the borders of the [From.GetName]. It would appear that they have fully embraced the technology of cybernetics. It is now mandatory for all of their citizens to have basic cybernetics and neural implants installed through surgery.

This has resulted in sweeping changes to their society - reports from [From.Capital.GetName] suggest that even simple acts like using an elevator or operating an air car require cybernetic implants now. In fact, the changes to their species have been so significant that they now call themselves the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'.

texts.zh:
有消息传来，[From.GetName]境内发生了显著的变化。看起来他们完全接受了义体科技。对他们的公民来说，通过外科手术加装义体和神经植入体是强制性的。

这对他们的社会造成了显著改变——来自[From.Capital.GetName]的报告指出，连一些最简单的行为比如坐电梯和驾驶空中汽车都需要依靠义体植入体。实际上，他们物种的变化十分显著，乃至他们现在已经改称自己为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”。
texts.en:
Word is leaking out of significant changes taking place within the borders of the [From.GetName]. It would appear that they have fully embraced the technology of cybernetics. It is now mandatory for all of their citizens to have basic cybernetics and neural implants installed through surgery.

This has resulted in sweeping changes to their society - reports from [From.Capital.GetName] suggest that even simple acts like using an elevator or operating an air car require cybernetic implants now. In fact, the changes to their species have been so significant that they now call themselves the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'.

texts.zh:
似乎邪恶之物开始在[From.GetName]境内扎根了。我们收到坏消息，那个星际国家的公民开始大规模突变他们的身体，把渎神的机械植入体装入体内，并作为生来便有的“恩赐”。

他们甚至把自己的物种重新命名为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”——进一步表明他们抛弃起源，拥抱冷酷无情的科技的决心。
texts.en:
It would appear that evil has taken root within the [From.GetName]. We have received troubling news that the citizens of that star nation are now mutilating their own bodies on a massive scale, installing profane mechanical implants in place of the body parts they were gifted with at birth.

They have even go so far as to rename their species to the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]' - yet another sign of their commitment to abandon their origins and embrace the cold soullessness of technology.

texts.zh:
邪恶之物又一次在[From.GetName]境内扎根。我们收到坏消息，那个星际国家的公民开始大规模突变他们的身体，把渎神的机械植入体装入体内，并作为生来便有的“恩赐”。

他们甚至把自己的物种重新命名为“[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]”——进一步表明他们抛弃起源，拥抱冷酷无情的科技的决心。
texts.en:
Evil has once again taken root within the [From.GetName]. We have received troubling news that the citizens of that star nation are now mutilating their own bodies on an even greater scale, installing new and profane mechanical implants in place of the few body parts they were gifted with at birth.

They have even go so far as to rename their species to the '[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]' - yet another sign of their commitment to abandon their organic origins and further embrace the cold soullessness of technology.

label.en: This is an affront to nature.

texts.zh:
蜂巢思维需要优越的躯体。有了义体植入体，我们就可以对工蜂进行改进、强化、重塑。
是时候超越我们生物学的极限了。

次月获得植入体的人口数：[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]
texts.en:
A Hive Mind needs superior bodies. With cybernetic implants, our drones can be perfected, enhanced, remodelled.
It is time to transcend the limits of our biology.

Pops to receive implants next month: [From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]

texts.zh:
我们的义体研究已经产出了多个有前途的义体原型供我们选择。初步结果表明，一些原型机在体力方面表现出色，而另一些则更适合精密工作。每一种都有其长处和局限性，没有一种具有压倒性优势。

我们意识中浮现出一个令人生畏的提议：我们可以让子个体变得多样化、根据功能不同的来改变身体吗？我们或许将变得不再完全相同。这样的未来难以把控，但也许对于我们整体的效率提高而言这是值得的。
texts.en:
Our cybernetic research has produced multiple promising cyborg prototypes for our consideration. Preliminary results show that some prototypes excel at physical feats, while others are more suited for precision work. Each has its strengths and limitations, none showing clear superiority.

A daunting proposal springs to our mind: Could we, perhaps, diversify our drones? Modify our bodies in different ways depending on their function? We won't be all identical anymore, a prospect we find hard to grasp. But the efficiency gain might make it worth our harmony.

tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Consciousness Shift.

texts.zh:
转化已经完成了。义体植入体经过了充分的测试、原型设计、优化、打磨并进行了安装，将我们的身体变为了完美的版本。

我们的工蜂现在具有更强的个体思维能力——更多的自由也带来了新的可能性。
texts.en:
The transformation is complete. Cybernetic implants have been tested, prototyped, refined, polished and installed, turning our bodies into perfected versions of themselves.

Our drones are now more capable of individual thoughts - and with greater freedom comes new possibilities.

texts.zh:
转化已经完成了。义体植入体经过了充分的测试、原型设计、优化、打磨并进行了安装，将我们的身体变为了完美的版本。

我们的工蜂比以往更加地团结了，金属的纽带强化了意识的联结。
texts.en:
The transformation is complete. Cybernetic implants have been tested, prototyped, refined, polished and installed, turning our bodies into perfected versions of themselves.

Our drones are now more united than ever, metallic chains strengthening the bond of the mind.

texts.zh:
转化已经完成了。义体植入体经过了充分的测试、原型设计、优化、打磨并进行了安装，将我们的身体变为了完美的版本。

在这个过中，我们发现了改变的机遇。我们的团结中蕴含着力量，但更多的自主工蜂也带来了一定的优势。
texts.en:
The transformation is complete. Cybernetic implants have been tested, prototyped, refined, polished and installed, turning our bodies into perfected versions of themselves.

During this process, we saw opportunities for change. There is strength in our union, but more autonomous drones also have their advantages.

texts.zh: 随着我们身体的演化，我们的蜂巢意识也可以发生蜕变。
texts.en: As our bodies evolve, so could our Hive Mind become something more.

texts.zh:
当在思考增强改造的本质时，我们也发现自己其实正在探索自己的愿望。

义体是达到目的的一种手段：它是一种优化我们的身体以更好地执行意志的方法。无限的强化改造是可能的，每一个强化体都将带来新的优势，但也带来了新的要求。机械肢体很重，网络大脑需要更多的能量，精密的部件也需要不断的维护。在通往完美的道路上，必须做出抉择。

要超越[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]局限、让机械化的[owner.GetSpeciesHandName]触及寰宇，我们的雄心壮志到底要聚焦何处？
texts.en:
As we ponder the nature of augmentation, we find ourselves exploring our aspirations.

Cyberization is a mean to an end: a way to optimize our bodies to better execute our will. Endless forms of augmentation are possible, each bringing new strengths, but also needs. Mechanical limbs are heavy, cyberbrains require more energy, and delicate components require constant maintenance. On the road to perfection, choices must be made.

What is the focus of our ambition, the one goal that requires transcending the limits of the [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] to stretch a metallic [owner.GetSpeciesHandName] across the sky?

texts.zh:
随着闲散的思考变成具体的计划，一种迫切的需求出现了：一个专门用于实验以及测试、建造义体原型的空间。

我们将建立一座强化改造中心，这样我们就可以把我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]拆开，用金属和梦想重新编织在一起。
texts.en:
As idle musings turn into concrete plans, a pressing need arises: a space devoted to experimentation, where cybernetic prototypes can be tested and built.

We shall raise an Augmentation Center, so we may rend our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] apart and reknit it together with metal and dreams.

label.zh: 是时候开始建设未来了。
label.en: Time to start building our future.

tooltips.zh:
需要采取行动：
建造一个£building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center']以恢复义体化局势。
tooltips.en:
Action required:
Build an £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] to resume the Cyberization situation.

texts.zh:
我们的义体原型通过了批准，强化改造中心也已经建好。我们的计划万事俱备，只剩下我们转化的后勤工作还没最终敲定下来。

我们可以下令所有的工蜂前往强化改造中心以进行转化流程，暂停他们的日常活动。这个过程会非常快速，但期间会让所有的工厂都停止运转。或者我们还可以安排工蜂的日日构成，在他们的强制休息期间进行义体人转化，以避免影响日常活动。这种计划尽管慢了点儿，但影响也小一些。
texts.en:
Our cyborg prototypes are approved. The Augmentation Center has been built. Our plan is ready, but the logistics of our transformation are yet to be finalized.

We could order all our drones to head to an Augmentation Center and undergo the procedure, suspending their daily activities. This process would be very fast, but would leave our factories empty until it is complete. Alternatively, we could work around our drones' schedules, turning them into cyborgs during their mandatory resting periods in order to not impact their activities. Although slower, this plan is less disruptive.

texts.zh:
安装神经植入体对工蜂造成了意料外的影响：由于大脑变成了半义体，他们现在可以独立于我们的主意识之外产生个体意识。

我们可以进一步开发这种科技，提升工蜂的自主思考能力。
texts.en:
Installing neural implants into our drones led to an unforeseen result: since their brains are now partly cybernetic, they can now form individual thoughts separated from our main consciousness.

We could further develop this technology, improving our drones' capability for autonomous thinking.

We will soon be ready to augment our biological bodies with machine parts. The processing power of the brain and the strength of limbs can be increased. The question is who will benefit the most from such augmentation.

title.en: By the People, For the People

texts.zh:
由于我们计划的许多义体设计对普通人来说都将会遥不可及，一些自改造者们感到非常愤怒。

他们认为如果公开原理图并放松有关的环境法规，几乎每个人都能制造和修理自己的强化体。
texts.en:
Self-modders are furious that many of our planned cybernetic designs will be inaccessible to the average person.

They argue that if the schematics were made public and environmental regulations relaxed, almost everyone will be able to manufacture and repair their own augmentations.

texts.zh:
独立承包商们抱怨称难以获取我们计划的许多义体设计。

他们认为如果公开蓝图，并将与生产有关的专利放松，将能改善义体的生产。
texts.en:
Independent contractors complain that many of our planned cybernetic designs are inaccessible to them.

They argue that if the schematics were made available and patents related to production relaxed, implant production could be improved.

label.zh: 法律法规的存在不是无缘无故的。

texts.zh:
由政府出资研究项目所进行的小规模测试已确认机械强化改造可以提升产出。

是时候上马一些规模更大的示范项目了。这需要持续的投入而且只会在建有强化改造中心的行星进行，但所获得的经验能马上提高生产力。
texts.en:
Small tests conducted by government-funded research projects have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.

The time has come for more widespread pilot projects. These require continuous support and will only be available on planets with an Augmentation Center, but our learnings will give immediate productivity benefits.

texts.zh:
对焦点志愿小组进行的小规模测试已经验证了机械强化改造可以提升产出。

是时候上马一些规模更大的示范项目了。这需要持续的投入而且只会在建有强化改造中心的行星进行，但所获得的经验能马上提高生产力。
texts.en:
Small tests conducted on focus group volunteers have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.

The time has come for more widespread pilot projects. These require continuous support and will only be available on planets with an Augmentation Center, but our learnings will give immediate productivity benefits.

texts.zh:
来自自改造者的报道验证了机械强化改造可以提升产出。

是时候上马一些规模更大的示范项目了。这需要持续的投入而且只会在建有强化改造中心的行星进行，但所获得的经验能马上提高生产力。
texts.en:
Reports by self-modders have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.

The time has come for more widespread pilot projects. These require continuous support and will only be available on planets with an Augmentation Center, but our learnings will give immediate productivity benefits.

texts.zh:
反对将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融为一体的宗教团体主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。在实践中，他们甚至缺乏最基本的植入体，这使得他们难以在我们这个日益紧密联系起来的社会中发挥作用。

强制要求每个人都安装完整的植入体将有助于他们更好地融入社会，但无疑会导致怨恨。
texts.en:
Religious groups opposed to the merging of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. In practice, they lack even the most basic implants, making it difficult to function in our increasingly connected society.

Forcing the population to install full implants would help them to better integrate with society, but would undoubtedly lead to resentment.

texts.zh:
不情愿将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机械苟同的虔信者们主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。在实践中，他们甚至缺乏最基本的植入体，这使得他们难以在我们这个日益紧密联系起来的社会中发挥作用。

强制要求每个人都安装完整的植入体将有助于他们更好地融入社会，但无疑会导致怨恨。
texts.en:
The faithful, understandably reluctant to merge [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine, have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. In practice, they lack even the most basic implants, making it difficult to function in our increasingly connected society.

Forcing the population to install full implants would help them to better integrate with society, but would undoubtedly lead to resentment.

texts.zh:
将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融合的道德性是个长久以来为人津津乐道的话题。不幸的是，考虑到义体化带来的效率提高，那些选择退出的人可能处于不利地位。

强迫人们安装植入体可以确保所有人都不会掉队，但这也无疑会导致怨恨。
texts.en:
The morality of merging [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine has long been a subject of debate. Unfortunately, given the increased efficiency that results from cyberization, those who opt out may be at a disadvantage.

Forcing the population to install implants would ensure that no one is left behind, but it will also undoubtedly lead to resentment.

texts.zh:
再次融合[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机器的道德性是个长久以来为人津津乐道的话题。然而，我们自主设计的增强器不再受同化我们的机器摆布，因此效率极高。那些选择推出的人可能会处于不利地位。

强迫人们安装植入体可以确保所有人都不会掉队，但这也无疑会导致怨恨。
texts.en:
The morality of once again merging [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine has long been a subject of debate. However, augments of our own design are no longer bound to the whims of the Machine that assimilated us, and as such are exceedingly efficient. Those who opt out may be at a disadvantage.

Forcing the population to install implants would ensure that no one is left behind, but it will also undoubtedly lead to resentment.

texts.zh:
由于跟不上公众对控制植入体的采用，我们的立法者正在尽其所能限制某些方面的强化改造。

最新提出的法规谴责我们“植入体成瘾”，每一次强化改造都“让我们离[Owner.Species.GetName]的定义越来越远”，并设定了一个每个人的强化体比例上限，只有在该限度之内才资格受到法律保护。毕竟，在某种程度上，我们有会变得更像机器而不是[Owner.Species.GetName]的风险。
texts.en:
Unable to keep up with the public's adoption of cybernetic implants, our lawmakers are doing everything they can to restrict certain aspects of augmentation.

Decrying our "implant obsession," with each augmentation "taking us further away from what it means to be a [Owner.Species.GetName]," the latest proposed regulations set a maximum augmentation percentage per person allowed to still qualify for protection under the law. After all, at some point we risk becoming more machine than [Owner.Species.GetName].

texts.zh:
最近，一种引人疑虑的新型义体植入体得到了广泛的关注。这些植入体的设计不是为了帮助使用者，而是为了伤害他人：这些毒素喷雾器、纳米绞杀器和电子大脑干扰器席卷了大街小巷。

支持者认为，这些植入体对于自卫是必要的，而其他人则坚持认为，这种技术不可能带来任何好处。
texts.en:
Recently, a dubious new variety of cybernetic implant has been gaining traction. These implants are not designed to help the user, but rather to injure others: toxin sprayers, nano garrottes, and cyberbrain scramblers flood our streets.

Proponents argue that these implants are necessary for self defense, while others insist no good can possibly come of such technology.

texts.zh:
尽管我们向入侵安全系统的组织支付了巨额赎金，但昨晚我们的主要代码库还是被上传到了所有公共信息网络。泄露的内容开头还附带一张淫秽图片，嘲笑我们无力阻止攻击。

公众舆论逐渐发酵，对控制植入体的“买家懊悔”明显增加了。
texts.en:
Despite paying a massive ransom to the groups responsible for the security breach, late last night our primary code base was uploaded to on every public information network. The leak was preceded by an obscene graphic, mocking our inability to prevent the attacks.

Public discourse has already turned bitter, with a noticeable increase in 'buyer's remorse' for cybernetic implants.

texts.zh:
重写植入体控制程序费时费力，减慢了产出的节奏。

由于民众越来越依赖于最新的强化体，许多人走上街头抗议产品的延期发售。
texts.en:
Rewriting the implant control software has taken time and effort, and slowed down production.

The population has become ever more dependent on the latest augments, and many have taken to the streets to protest delayed product launches.

texts.zh:
今天是我们社会的一个转折点。我们终于得以用全内置机械部件来强化改造自己的躯体。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today marks a turning point for our society. We are now able to augment our bodies with fully-integrated machine parts.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

texts.zh:
对我们人民的强化改造是一场流水线生产流程和决策指定的重大胜利。众多不同的声音得到了倾听，他们所关切的问题也得到了解决。如今，每一名[root.GetSpeciesAdj]都有平等的机会享受这些改变一生的植入体。

合乎逻辑的下一步是对这项技术的更广泛影响进行研究。我们是利用它来推动民主进程，还是通过经验同步来提升我们的劳工？
texts.en:
The augmentation of our people has been a triumph of streamlined manufacturing processes and decision-making. Our multitude of distinct voices have been acknowledged with their concerns addressed. Now, every single [root.GetSpeciesAdj] has equal opportunity to benefit from these life-altering implants.

The logical next step is to examine the wider implications of this technology. Are we to leverage it for the democratic process or elevate our workers via experience synchronization?

texts.zh:
我们与合作公司的强化改造流程已经成功完成。植入体以惊人的效率制造、分发和安装。我们听取了[root.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的许多意见，他们的合理关切也得到了处理。我们已经准备好了以全新的活力面对未来。

政府现在准备采取下一步行动。我们可以利用技术进步来改善民主进程，或者为劳动者进行植入体同步。
texts.en:
The augmentation process with our partnered corporations has been successfully completed. Implants have been manufactured, distributed, and installed with staggering efficiency. The many voices of [root.GetSpeciesAdj] society have been heard, and their legitimate concerns have been dealt with. We are ready to face the future with renewed vigor.

The government is now prepared to take its own next step. We can use our technological advances to improve the democratic process or synchronize implants in the service of workers.

texts.zh:
尽管政府官员有些担心，但植入体的去中心化分发模式还是奏效了。小诊所和服务机构如雨后春笋般出现在大街小巷，让人们无需长途跋涉就能完成自身的强化改造。

我们的政府也必须做好继续前进的准备。我们可以利用技术进步来改善民主流程，或是进行经验同步，为自己与劳动者们造福。
texts.en:
Despite some apprehension from government officials, the decentralized distribution model of the implants has worked. Small clinics and services are popping up on every street corner allowing anyone to augment themselves without having to travel great distances.

Our government must be ready to move on as well. We can either use the implants to strengthen our democratic process or use them to synchronize our experiences for the benefits of ourselves and the workers.

label.zh: 我们应该促进民主进程。
label.en: We should enhance the democratic process.

label.zh: 我们必须将意识连接到一起。

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重提升幸福度、劳工产出和稳定度。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on increased happiness, worker output and stability.

texts.zh:
我们不安于自然所给予的现状，努力地超越了有机躯体的极限。全面铺开的植入体应用只遭遇了微不足道的问题，并且都已逐一迎刃而解。绝大多数人口为全新的义体所带来的一切感到欣喜若狂。

我们正站在成就伟大的大门前，未来可期。
texts.en:
We refuse to settle for what nature provided, and instead strive to exceed the limits of the organic body. Our full-scale distribution of implants has encountered only minor issues, all of which can be easily resolved. The vast majority of the population is exhilarated by what their new cybernetics offer.

We truly stand on the precipice of greatness. What happens next remains to be seen.

texts.zh:
这种里程碑式的转变只能由社会上层的来理解和实施，以免在我们的臣民中产生混乱和分歧。当[Species.GetNamePlural]被安装上政府分发的义体植入体时，我们获得了一个绝无仅有的探索这些芯片提供全新可能性的机会。

我们应该为社会创造激烈的竞争，让我们的工人提升到全新的高度，还是应该利用起睡眠中闲置的计算能力呢？
texts.en:
This monumental shift can only be understood and enacted by the upper echelon of society, lest it leads to confusion and disagreements within our subjects. While the [Species.GetNamePlural] are fitted with their government-issued cybernetic implants, and we have a unique opportunity to explore untapped opportunities these chips now afford.

Should we push for a society where fierce competition raises our workers to new heights or harness the idle computational power of the sleeping minds?

texts.zh:
随着政府批准的公司开始大量生产不断改进的生物芯片，我们必须决定以何种方式来利用好这一次令人难以置信的社会变革。

我们是应该模仿优胜劣汰的自然选择，还是发掘沉睡中的大脑尚未开发的潜力?
texts.en:
As government-sanctioned corporations churn out ever-improving biochips, we must make a decision on how to best utilize this incredible societal change.

Should we mimic nature, where only the strongest survive, or nurture the untapped potential of the slumbering brain?

texts.zh:
不管是好是坏，人们都将有机会通过制造和分销的义体强化硬件来证明自己，让我们可以自由地考虑大局，并决定如何最大限度地利用这种不可预见的社会转变。

我们是应该促使人们完成更高的生产配额，还是让他们在睡梦中为我们工作？
texts.en:
For better or worse, the people will be allowed to prove themselves in manufacturing and distributing the cyber-augmentation hardware, freeing us to consider the big picture and how to make the most of this unforeseen societal shift.

Should we push people to meet ever higher quotas, or instead, make them work for us in their sleep?

label.zh: 让那些马屁精们为我们呕心沥血吧。
label.en: Have the sycophants toil for us.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重以降低幸福度为代价提升生产力。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on increased production at the cost of happiness.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 强调利用派系获取额外资源。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on leveraging factions for extra resources.

texts.zh:
在我们的强化改造计划中出现了许多提升稳定性和控制力的机遇。在我们为政府生产植入体并在人口中广泛地安装的过程中，秘密地嵌入可以引导人口实现更高生产力的算法可谓小菜一碟。

我们可以通过在个人植入体中添加监控和后门程序来增加监视能力，或者我们可以安装代码，让我们[Ruler.GetTitle]光芒四射的人格影响大众。
texts.en:
Several opportunities to increase stability and control have appeared within our augmentation program. As we manufacture government-issued implants and install them across our population, secretly installing algorithms to guide the population toward a preferred outcome would be easy.

We could increase our surveillance coverage by adding monitoring and backdoor tools to personal implants, or we could install code that allows our [Ruler.GetTitle]'s radiant personality to influence the masses.

texts.zh:
我们的合作伙伴公司已经准备好在社会范围内制造、分发和安装义体植入体，而即将到来的固件更新为我们提供了一个独特的机会。

我们可以在个人强化硬件中秘密嵌入监控工具，这样就能找出有问题的人，或者可以创造一个人格覆写函数，将[Ruler.GetTitle]的意志烙印在大众的心中。
texts.en:
Our partner corporations are ready to manufacture, distribute, and install cybernetic implants on a societal scale, and an upcoming firmware update provides us with a unique opportunity.

We could include hidden surveillance tools to personal augmentation hardware, allowing us to root out problematic individuals. Alternatively, we can create a personality override function that imprints the will of our [Ruler.GetTitle] the masses.

texts.zh:
综合医院、街角商店和骇客群体现在正准备分发并在大众身上安装义体植入体。但是，没有必要把我们的权力如此完全地分散到这项令人兴奋的新技术上。

我们可以提供客订化的植入体修改，把秘密监视工具隐藏其中，以对有问题的个人进行密切关注，或者我们可以安装人格覆盖算法，让我们[Ruler.GetTitle]的意志在潜意识中引导人民走向伟大。
texts.en:
General hospitals, corner shops, and hacker communities are now ready to distribute and install cybernetic implants on the populace. But there is no need to decentralize our power over this new and exciting technology so wholly.

We could provide custom implant modifications, with our own covert surveillance tools hidden within, to be able to keep tabs on problematic individuals. Alternatively, we could install personality-overriding algorithms that will allow the will of our [Ruler.GetTitle] to subconsciously guide our people towards greatness.

label.zh: 在个人植入体中藏入监视工具。
label.en: Hide surveillance tools in personal implants.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于帝国的稳定性和犯罪率降低。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on empire stability and crime reduction.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于劳工产出和强制迁移。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on worker production and resettlement.

texts.zh:
政府已有效地调配了庞大的资源来进行人口的强化。政府批准的强化改造中心日夜不停地安装，并指导人们如何正确地使用、维护植入体。

现在的问题是，植入体的实际价值是应该集中在增强我们已经令人印象深刻的领导力上，还是作为下属娱乐和分散注意力的一种手段。

为我们的皇室制造最高质量的植入体可以让我们的领导层得以在代际保存知识，不可估量地提高稳定性。或者帝国可以提升首都的地位，让义体强化的运动员在这里参与最极端的体育盛事。
texts.en:
The government has deployed its vast resources to augment the population efficiently. Sanctioned augmentation centers have been installing implants day and night, and people have been instructed on proper usage and maintenance practices.

The question is whether the actual value of implants should be focused on enhancing our already impressive leadership or as a means to entertain and distract those who work under them.

Having the highest quality implants available to our dynasty could allow our leadership to preserve knowledge between generations, providing immeasurable stability. Or, the empire can elevate the capital and entertain with cybernetically enhanced athletes participating in state-of-the-art bloodsport events.

texts.zh:
官方批准的公司正在执行着操作指令。所有的人口都以义体植入体进行了强化，并准备好了以前所未有的效率提供服务。

现在的问题是应该将植入体的实际价值集中在哪里。

为我们的皇室制造最高质量的植入体可以让我们的领导层得以在代际保存知识，不可估量地提高稳定性。或者帝国可以提升首都的地位，让义体强化的运动员在这里参与最极端的体育盛事。
texts.en:
Officially sanctioned corporations have performed within operational directives. The entire population has been augmented with cybernetic implants and is ready to serve more efficiently than ever before.

The question now is where the actual value of implants should be focused on.

Having the highest quality implants available to our dynasty could allow our leadership to preserve knowledge between generations, providing immeasurable stability. Or, the empire can elevate the capital and entertain with cybernetically enhanced athletes participating in state-of-the-art bloodsport events.

texts.zh:
尽管有许多帝国官员持保留意见，但义体植入体的去中心化分配安装已经取得了成功。各个星球上的小诊所一直在不知疲倦地努力强化改造我们的人口。

现在的问题是植入体的真正价值应该集中在什么方面。我们可以让统治者的知识储存在代际植入体中，或者为大众提供前所未见的义体人体育盛事。
texts.en:
Despite numerous reservations from imperial officials, decentralized distribution and installation of cybernetic implants has been successful. Multiple small clinics across our worlds have been working tirelessly to enhance our population.

The question now is where the actual value of implants should be focused. This could mean preserving imperial knowledge within intergenerational implants or providing the masses with cyborg bloodsport, the likes that have never before been viewed by any ocular implant.

tooltips.zh: 影响进行中的义体社会变迁。
tooltips.en: Influences the ongoing Cybernetic Society Shift.

tooltips.zh: 着重于首都星球的生产力和幸福度。
tooltips.en: Emphasis on capital planet productivity and happiness.

texts.zh:
庞大而徒劳的政府植入体计划即将完成，这为我们带来了进一步扩大与这一前所未有的产品发布相关的收入来源的机会。我们的分析团队提出了两种潜在的收入来源，两者都有各自的风险和回报。

政府是否应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
texts.en:
The expansive yet ineffectual government implant program nears completion, presenting us with an opportunity to further expand revenue sources related to this unprecedented product launch. Our analytics team is proposing two potential sources of income, both with their own risks and rewards.

Should the government require the inclusion of advertising in all future ocular implants, or mandate regular upgrades for the augmented population?

texts.zh:
得益于我们高度优化的企业基础设施，植入体的生产和安装与预期一样高效。这些新型植入体实际上带来了无穷无尽的商机。

其中有两条特别有前途的途径。虽然相互排斥，但两种方案的利润率都很高。

问题是，我们应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
texts.en:
Implant production and installation is as efficient as expected from our highly optimized corporate infrastructure. The business opportunities of these new implants are practically endless.

Two particularly promising avenues present themselves. While mutually exclusive, both predict stellar profit margins.

The question is, should we require the inclusion of advertising in all future ocular implants, or mandate regular upgrades for the augmented population?

texts.zh:
不出所料，义体件杂乱无章的“公共”植入正走向一个仁慈的结尾。我们现在还有机会影响这项有前途的新技术的发展方向，并在此过程中提高我们的产品利润率。

应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
texts.en:
Unsurprisingly, the haphazard "communal" implementation of cyberware is coming to its merciful end. We now have the opportunity to influence the direction of this promising new technology, raising our product margins in the process.

Should advertisements be included in all future ocular implants, or would it be better to mandate a continuous upgrade cycle for software and wetware?

texts.zh:
最近在高等义体植入体方面的突破有朝一日将产生重塑社会的可能性。我们可以消除一切生物学弱点，变得更快、更强、更聪明。

各大企业提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而政府官员则坚持必须保证由国家来控制这种潜在的技术。
texts.en:
Recent breakthroughs in advanced cybernetic implants will one day make it possible to reshape society. By eliminating any biological weakness, we can make ourselves smarter, faster, stronger.

Corporations have provided business proposals and sales projections, while government officials argue that access to this potential technology must be guaranteed by the state.

texts.zh:
最近在高等义体植入体方面的突破有朝一日将产生重塑社会的可能性。我们可以消除一切生物学弱点，变得更快、更强、更聪明。

各分包商提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而我们的董事会则坚持必须保证这种重要技术在垄断范围之内。
texts.en:
Recent breakthroughs in advanced cybernetic implants will one day make it possible to reshape society. By eliminating any biological weakness, we can make ourselves smarter, faster, stronger.

Sub-contractors have provided business proposals and sales projections for third-party implant production, while our board of directors argues that access to this important technology must remain within our monopoly.

texts.zh:
最近在高等义体植入体方面的突破有朝一日将产生重塑社会的可能性，这次将由我们自己掌控。通过消除现有增强技术中的生物学缺陷和弱点，我们可以使自己变得更聪明、更快、更强壮。

各大企业提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而政府官员则坚持必须保证由国家来控制这种潜在的技术。
texts.en:
Recent breakthroughs in advanced cybernetic implants will one day make it possible to reshape society, this time on our own terms. By eliminating biological weaknesses and defects in our existing augments, we can make ourselves smarter, faster, stronger.

Corporations have provided business proposals and sales projections, while government officials argue that access to this potential technology must be guaranteed by the state.

texts.zh:
最近在高等义体植入体方面的突破有朝一日将产生重塑社会的可能性，这次将由我们自己掌控。通过消除现有增强技术中的生物学缺陷和弱点，我们可以使自己变得更聪明、更快、更强壮。

分包商提供了第三方植入体生产的商业提案和销售前景预测，而我公司董事会则坚持这项重要技术的准入必须保持在我们垄断之下。
texts.en:
Recent breakthroughs in advanced cybernetic implants will one day make it possible to reshape society, this time on our own terms. By eliminating biological weaknesses and defects in our existing augments, we can make ourselves smarter, faster, stronger.

Sub-contractors have provided business proposals and sales projections for third-party implant production, while our board of directors argues that access to this important technology must remain within our monopoly.

texts.zh:
经过一段时间的政治内斗，生产义体强化件的责任终于被瓜分到到了各个政府部门中。当他们都能分一杯羹时，肯定会互相进行监督。

但计划终究要付诸行动。科研共同体至少需要一座强化改造中心来作为义体发展的中心。
texts.en:
After a period of political infighting, the responsibilities for producing cybernetic augmentations have been divided between various governmental departments. When everyone gets a piece of the pie, they will surely keep each other in check.

But plans must be put into action. The research community requires at least one Augmentation Center to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

texts.zh:
曾经的梦想现在触手可及，无疑我们境内众多的公司能从中大幅获利。义体行业蓬勃发展的一个好处是，新的消费产品推陈出新的速度越来越快了。

但计划终究要付诸行动。企业说客请愿建立一座$building_upload_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
texts.en:
What was once a dream is now within reach, and who better to profit from it than the multitude of corporations within our borders? A benefit of the burgeoning cybernetic industry vigor is that new consumer products can be launched at an accelerated pace.

But plans must be put into action. The corporate lobbyists request at least one $building_upload_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

texts.zh:
我们的通讯网络充斥着各种疯狂的设计构想，从神经突触强化件到义体味觉腺无所不有。其中大多数都非常不切实际，而且实现起来非常昂贵，尽管有些设计看起来还是很有希望的。

但计划终究要付诸行动。线上社群至少需要一座强化改造中心来作为义体发展的中心。
texts.en:
Our communication networks are abuzz with wild design ideas, everything from neuro-synaptic augmentation to cybernetic taste glands. Most of these would be highly impractical and very expensive to implement, though luckily some designs appear promising.

But plans must be put into action. The online community requires at least one Augmentation Center to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

我们在全国各地的所有主要城市中心为[Owner.Species.GetName]民众们囤积了大量的机械植入体。这些由强化师们设计的装置保证可以大幅提高我们的生理机能。

抛弃过往迎接义体未来的这一天终于到了。
texts.en:
All across our territory, in every major urban center, we have stockpiled mechanical implants for our [Owner.Species.GetName] population. Designed by our Augmentors, these devices promise to greatly enhance our biological forms.

The day is finally here to cast off our past and embrace a cybernetic future.

texts.zh:
目睹了监管宽松的强化改造行业带来的利润，当地政府官员一直在争先恐后地跟上最新的发展。从资源开采到最终安装，控制植入体生产的每个阶段都要征收大幅税额。

过分的官僚主义和高昂的费用已经减缓了我们的强化改造进度，阻碍了全面义体化的进程。
texts.en:
Witnessing the profits in the loosely regulated augmentation industry, local government officials have been scrambling to keep up with the latest developments. Broad taxes have been levied on every stage of cybernetic implant production, from resource extraction to final installation.

The additional bureaucracy and expense have slowed down our augmentation process, impeding progress toward full cyberization.

texts.zh:
在对利润的狂热追逐中，强化改造市场充斥着廉价、低质的植入体，在这些设备不可避免地发生故障时，公司也拒绝提供客户支持。

在一个最近广为报道的案例中，一位著名演员在舞台上表演时，心脏调节植入体发生了故障。不幸的是，结果是爆炸性的。
texts.en:
In the heady rush for profit, the augmentation market has been flooded by cheap, low-quality implants, with companies offering no customer support when these devices inevitably break down.

In one recent, well-publicized case, a popular performer's heart-modulating implant malfunctioned while on stage. The result was, unfortunately, explosive.

label.en: The market will sort itself out.

texts.zh:
在一次协同攻击中，多个黑客组织协力盗取了驱动所有植入体的核心软件。他们威胁称，如果我们不答应他们的要求，就要把代码公布于众。

到目前为止，我们没有理由怀疑他们的决心。如果代码被公开，我们将别无选择，只能进行重写，这种延迟将对我们的强化改造工作造成毁灭性的影响。
texts.en:
In a coordinated attack, multiple hacker groups have gained access to the core software that powers all cybernetic implants. They are threatening to release the code to the public unless we give in to their demands.

Thus far, we have no reason to doubt their resolve. Should the code be made public, we will have no choice but to rewrite it, a delay that will have a devastating impact on our augmentation efforts.
